contentHtml:
The lenient visa policies of the UAE have led to various investors, businessmen, workers, and laborers to land in Dubai for business and employment opportunities from different countries of the world. That is why the residency visa issuance has a certain criteria that an individual must meet.

Over 80% of the population in Dubai is comprised of expats and foreigners settled here for their work. That is why everyone must know how to renew residence visa in Dubai.

In this article, we will discuss how you can process your visa renewal in Dubai, what documents you will be required for residence visa in Dubai, and what the procedure for renewal is.

Benefits of Residence Visa Renewal Dubai

If you have a valid residence visa in Dubai, you will get various benefits in the UAE for it. However, with expired residency visa, these benefits may not be availed and even, you may face penalties. That is why it is for most necessity to renew your residency visa as soon as you see the deadline for its expiry is near.

It is because not only your legal status to stay in the Dubai will be maintained but you will be likely to avail of the following benefits of visa renewal in Dubai:

Bank Account or Loan

To open a Bank Account in any of the Dubai-based bank or to acquire the loan for personal finances, your residency visa must be up-to-dated. If it gets expired, you must opt for visa renewal as soon as possible because it will make you law compliant expatriate in Dubai, UAE. It is recommended that you start earlier than the expiry date of your residency visa so that you do not have to rush at the last moment and left some room for official processes.

Government Healthcare and Insurance

To acquire the healthcare insurance is the necessity for residence visa in Dubai, UAE. However, upon the expiry of your residence visa in Dubai, you cannot avail of any services related to healthcare or buy any healthcare insurance plan. That is why it is necessary that you must opt for visa renewal as soon as possible if it gets expired. It will keep you law compliant in Dubai, UAE. You must start earlier than your residency visa expiry date so that you do not have to rush at the last moment and have ample time for official processes.

Visa-less travel to various countries

You can travel to various countries in the middle-east region with a valid residency visa in Dubai without having tourist or visit visa. However, with expired residency visa, you’ll not be able to travel freely to any of the GCC or Middle East countries. That is why you must know how to renew residence visa in in Dubai so that you can kick start the process as soon as possible if your residency permit gets expired. You will be law compliant resident in Dubai, UAE by starting visa renew process earlier than its expiry date and provide time for official processes.

Obtaining a driver’s license

You can only get the driver’s license in Dubai through a valid residency visa in Dubai. If your residency visa in Dubai expires during the driving license acquisition process, then it is likely that you’ll not get your Dubai driving license. That is why you have to learn how to renew residence visa in in Dubai so that you can process its renewal immediately upon its expiry date is near. If your residency visa’s expiry date is near, you should contact the immigration for official processes promptly.

Your Children are eligible to enroll in schools

There are various prominent schools, and universities in Dubai for the best education of your children. And if you do not have valid residency visa in Dubai, you cannot let your children study in public and private schools in Dubai.

Steps to follow for Residence Visa Renewal in Dubai

The procedure for renewal of residence visa in Dubai is easier than you thought of. However, if you are renewing it for the first time, you must seek assistance from experts and learn how to renew residence visa in Dubai. In addition, you can get our services at minimal rates and the rest is up to us.

Here are the steps involved in the process of Dubai residence visa renewal:

Complete the Emirates ID Application

  • First you need to renew your Emirates ID online through the authorized website of the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs, and Port Security in Dubai.
  • You can also renew through a PRO or any registered Dubai visa agency.
  • Typically, the cost for renewal process ranges from AED 200 to AED 400.

Complete the Medical Fitness Test

  • You must get your medical fitness test after getting new Emirates ID.
  • It ensures that you’re still healthy and fit to live in Dubai, UAE.
  • The test is conducted at Dubai Health Authority and Authorized Medical Fitness Centers.
  • AED 250 is the cost for the entire medical fitness test.

Renew the Residence Permit

  • Upon receiving the medical fitness certificate, you can proceed to residence visa renewal in Dubai.
  • You must submit your documents required for residence visa in Dubai through the online portal, a PRO, or a registered Visa Agency.
  • The cost for renewing the residence visa is AED 200 approximately.

Collect the New Emirates ID and Residence Permit

  • As soon as your application is approved, collect your Emirates ID and renewed residence visa.
  • The residence visa will be issued as a sticker on your passport.
  • Your Emirates ID can be collected from the nearest Emirate Post Office branch.

How long does the process take?

According to the official website of Federal Authority For Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security Dubai, the total time for the residence visa renewal in Dubai is 48 hours.

Which documents are required?

If you’re sponsored by a company in Dubai or your family is sponsoring you, there may be slight variation in both cases. Also it depends on the visa type that what documents required for residence visa in Dubai. However, here are some of the documents that you must submit:

  1. Sponsored person’s recent color photograph with a white background.
  2. Passport copy.
  3. Approved medical fitness certificate by authorities for individuals over 18 years old.
  4. Receipt Emirates ID application.
  5. Employment contract.
  6. Attested accommodation lease or proof of accommodation ownership by the sponsor.
  7. Copy of sponsor’s passport with valid residency.
  8. Medical Insurance (required for Abu Dhabi visas).

Final Thoughts

You must now know how to renew residence visa in in Dubai. Keep in mind that 30 days to six months is the grace period for residence visa renewal in Dubai. However, it is not recommended that you wait till the expiry date of your visa and renew it as soon as possible.
